jcr:title: Xpedition powered stair chair
jcr:description: Xpedition, Stryker's first powered stair chair, has uniquely designed features to help decrease your effort while transporting patients and increase your patients' comfort – because the journey is just as important as the destination.

Introducing the Xpedition powered stair chair - the powered stair chair for emergency responders.

text.text: The powered stair chair for EMS.

largeheadline_copy_c_1668644064.line1:
PRODUCT HIGHLIGHTS

Xpedition powered stair chair

text.text:
Integrates with your workflow 

  • Maintains the same folded storage footprint as Stryker’s Stair-PRO stair chair while increasing the width of the seat pan, allowing for a wider range of patients. 
  • Enhance visibility with an intuitive user interface, backlit indicator buttons and bright lights. Two "go" buttons and multiple speed options allow the caregiver to customize their approach. 
  • Stryker's Xpedition and Power-PRO 2 powered ambulance cot share the same universal lithium-ion battery and battery charger.

standaloneimage.alt: Examples on how Stryker's power stair chair enhances the EMS workflow

standaloneimage_1102.alt: EMTs using the secure patient containment system on the motorized stair chair

text_copy.text:
Designed for increased safety*

  • Reduced patient tip back while on the stairs, in combination with Stryker's patient containment system, to help improve patient psychological and physical safety. 
  • Allows caregivers to safely and ergonomically move patients up and down stairs, utilizing a powered track to help decrease the risk of caregiver injury and fatigue.
  • Integrated head end and foot end lights allows emergency responders to easily see the environment around them and their patients.

text.text:
Enhances the care experience 

  • Seamlessly navigate through a variety of terrains and environments on large wheels.
  • Designed to help prevent damage to staircases with a flexible belt that conforms to stairs for maximum traction.
  • Easily maneuver over obstacles and transition to stairs with improved track ground clearance.

standaloneimage.alt: Stryker's motorized stair chair enhances the patient care experience
